## Problem and resulting behaviour

Explain the user need and what changes. Link the related issue where applicable.

## Affected components or tokens

List the relevant APIs, styles or documentation. Include neutral before/after screenshots for visual changes.

## Validation

Record checks run and results. Explain checks not run or remaining limitations.

- [ ] Relevant Storybook states, keyboard behaviour and mobile layout reviewed
- [ ] Automated checks appropriate to this change passed
- [ ] Package consumption verified if exports, dependencies, styles or behaviour changed
- [ ] Documentation and changelog updated where needed
- [ ] No client data, credentials or licensed font files included

For documentation-only changes, mark interaction and package checks as not applicable.

## Compatibility and migration

State whether consumers need to change anything. Describe migration steps and how to revert if needed.
